caption: 💌Do not forget to Follow @Bella.HealthyTinyTummies for more simple, real-food snacks for toddlers 🍎🍌 💡 Homemade Pear & Spelt Crackers with 6 ingredients, no junk! These pear crackers are rich in fiber, magnesium, and crunch 👌 perfect for toddlers who love finger food. 🍐 Ingredients 2 cup (240g) spelt flour 1 tbsp sesame seeds 1/4 tsp cinnamon 1 tbsp olive oil 1 Egg 1 pear (grated & well-drained) 👩‍🍳 Instructions Mix → Roll thin( 2-3 mm) → Cut →pock it with a fork (that’s how they get extra crunchy)→Bake 15–18 min at 180°C. Cool before serving. ✨ Calm, homemade, toddler-approved #EnergiKuatTiapLangkah #toddlerapproved #sugarfreesnacks #pear #homemadecrackers
